g.text: $ co --version
$ co gmail draft --help
Usage: python -m connectonion.cli.main gmail draft [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
Create, inspect, and edit Gmail drafts; sending always asks for confirmation.
│ --help Show this message and exit. │
│ list List Gmail drafts, numbered for later draft commands. │
│ create Create an unsent Gmail draft. │
│ attach Stage a local/Drive file, or append a Drive link, without sending. │
│ remove Remove one staged attachment; the draft remains unsent. │
│ replace Atomically replace one staged attachment without sending. │
│ preview Print recipients, body, and the final attachment manifest. │
│ review Review the complete outgoing content and produce its confirmation token. │
│ send Send reviewed MIME; require a token or default-No interactive confirmation. │
$ co syno --help
Usage: python -m connectonion.cli.main syno [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
Connect to a Synology NAS, inspect its state and manage everyday files. Bare co syno lists shared
folders.
│ --nas <str> Select a saved NAS for this invocation. │
│ --json Emit one JSON result; never prompt. │
│ --non-interactive Never prompt. │
│ --timeout <float> Command waiting budget in seconds (0 < seconds <= 3600). │
│ --help Show this message and exit. │
│ login Verify File Station access before saving a profile. HTTPS and interactive-only OTP; no │
│ secrets on argv. │
│ logout Clear local authentication even when remote session invalidation is unavailable; │
│ retain settings. │
│ status Inspect live connectivity and configured monitoring sources. Partial coverage exits 1. │
│ Operation checks never resubmit writes. │
│ ls List accessible shares or a full directory path. Default order is name ascending. Live │
│ pages can change. │
│ info Inspect a complete NAS file or directory path. │
│ search Search names in an explicit shared-directory scope. Wait for completion and clean the │
│ task before paging its snapshot. │
│ download Download without overwrite by default. Directories require --recursive; local parents │
│ must exist. Numeric migration rows require --listing. │
│ upload Upload into an existing NAS directory. Directories require --recursive and preserve │
│ their base name and empty directories. │
│ mkdir Create ordinary directories; never create DSM shared roots. │
│ copy Copy within one NAS without directory-tree merging. Pending task IDs survive restart; │
│ repeat this command only when continuation is requested. │
│ move Move or rename within one NAS. No self-descendant moves or existing-directory-tree │
│ merging. │
│ get Migration alias for download. Numeric rows always require their frozen --listing ID. │
│ put Migration alias for upload; all transfer safeguards and options apply. │
│ shares Migration alias for share list; URLs are hidden unless explicitly requested. │
│ nas Inspect saved NAS profiles and select the default. │
│ network Inspect NAS interfaces separately from client connectivity. │
│ storage Inspect the capacity and disk indicators supplied by the configured SNMPv3 source. │
│ service Enumerate services using explicitly configured SSH read commands. │
│ share Create, list and revoke sharing links. Legacy share PATH dispatches to create. │
Examples: co syno login --name home; co syno --nas home status; co syno ls /home/docs
